objective: Validate the current dsh-vision/image-mind 0.2.x source against exact @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.1 in a fully isolated temporary environment, focusing on the newly added multi-turn session image history routing and browser-side 9+ image fail-fast behavior. The real local Harness must remain read-only and dsh-vision/image-mind must remain uninstalled after the task.
context: PR #38 added privacy-preserving sessionBatchOffset routing so the model/tool can revisit earlier uploaded image batches without exposing attachment ids. PR #39 made the browser reject more than 8 images before reading drafts, uploading, sending, committing preview history, or releasing drafts, and made the browser and host tool share the same image-count limit. The current 0.2.0 packages are not published to npm, so this is a source-built isolated behavior regression, NOT a registry-release compatibility verdict. The executor may create temporary package copies/tarballs, temporary launcher/cache/DSH_HOME directories, temporary local stub servers, generated test images, and browser automation state outside the repository. It must not publish packages, change release metadata, or alter real Harness state. Use exact @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.1, preferably pre-resolved with pnpm to avoid the already-proven transient npm/npx Arborist stall. If a browser/main-model subcheck cannot run without unsafe access to real credentials/settings, mark only that subcheck PARTIAL and continue every keyless/local-stub check that is possible.

manual or direct edits to any real DeepSeek Harness profile, manifest, lockfile, settings file, credential file, cache, node_modules tree, plugin tree, or other Harness-owned state
any real Harness plugin add/install/reinstall/remove action for dsh-vision/image-mind
package publishing, npm dist-tag changes, tags, releases, or version bumps
writes to Ran-sh/dsh-crew or any repository other than Ran-sh/dsh-vision
credentials, API keys, secret values, signed URL secrets, attachment ids, or unredacted secret-bearing logs
validation: record exact source commit, OS, Node, npm, pnpm, and exact @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.1 versions
read-only verify at task start that the real local Harness does not actively compose dsh-plugin-image-mind or @ran-sh/dsh-vision; do not modify real Harness state even if inert residues exist

create task-owned temporary launcher/cache/DSH_HOME and source-package staging outside the repository; load the current source-built plugin into exact rc.1 using an isolated mechanism that does not mutate the real Harness and record the mechanism truthfully
prove the isolated composition uses the current source commit/artifacts rather than the published 0.1.x plugin line

exercise session image history with distinct generated image batches A then B and verify offset 0 resolves B while sessionBatchOffset 1 resolves A; prove the selected visual bytes/fingerprint or deterministic local-stub result without exposing attachment ids

restart the isolated host/runtime while preserving only the task-owned temporary DSH_HOME/attachment state and verify the committed prior batch can still be resolved by sessionBatchOffset after restart

in the actual isolated rc.1 web/client when possible without real credentials, attempt to send MAX_IMAGES_PER_REQUEST + 1 draft images and verify fail-fast occurs before any /image-mind upload, session message admission, preview commit, or draft release; verify an actionable max-8 error is surfaced and drafts remain available
verify a valid batch of exactly 8 images is not rejected by the client-side count guard; it may stop at a later model/provider boundary if no safe main-model credential is available
verify normal rendered conversation/UI output does not expose raw attachment ids, sha256 ids, local paths, signed URL query material, route telemetry, or persisted batch ids during these checks

if a safe keyless/local stub OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint can be used, route at least one current-source understand_image call through it and record only redacted request-count/route/model/provider evidence; do not use paid/unknown real credentials blindly
delete all task-owned temporary launcher/cache/DSH_HOME/package/browser/stub-server artifacts after evidence capture
final read-only verification that the real local Harness still does not actively compose dsh-plugin-image-mind/@ran-sh/dsh-vision and was not modified by this task
acceptance_criteria: The Task Contract validates before execution and the exact source SHA is recorded in the Result Contract.
The real local Harness remains read-only for the entire task and dsh-vision/image-mind remains uninstalled there after completion.
All source-built/runtime/browser testing that requires mutation occurs only in newly created task-owned temporary state outside the repository and outside the real Harness state.
The Result clearly distinguishes source-built 0.2.x regression evidence from published-package/registry compatibility; do not claim 0.2.0 registry compatibility from this task.
Repository typecheck, build, tests, package integrity, and built-artifact checks pass or failures are reported truthfully without product-code fixes in this TEST_ONLY task.

A/B history routing proves latest batch selection and previous-batch selection with distinct visual fixtures, with sessionBatchOffset 1 selecting A after B is newer. Do not infer success from metadata alone if a deterministic byte/fingerprint or local-stub observation can be captured.
Restart recovery proves previously committed session image history can be resolved after process/runtime restart using only the task-owned persisted attachment/index state.

For the 9-image browser case, PASS requires evidence that rejection happens before upload/message admission side effects and drafts are retained. If actual rc.1 browser automation is unavailable, mark this subcheck PARTIAL rather than substituting the existing unit test as real-browser evidence.
For the exactly-8 browser case, prove the count guard allows the batch to proceed beyond the guard. A later credential/provider/model blocker is allowed and must be reported separately.
No user-visible or captured diagnostic evidence may leak raw attachment ids, sha256 ids, local paths, signed URL query values, credentials, route telemetry, or persisted batch ids.

If a local keyless stub provider is used, successful current-source understand_image evidence must be attributable to the isolated current 0.2.x artifacts and exact rc.1 composition; record safe route/provider/model/request-count evidence only.

The Result Contract must state a plain-language verdict for each of: source-built rc.1 composition, A/B session history routing, restart recovery, 9-image browser fail-fast, exactly-8 guard allowance, privacy/redaction, and optional local-stub vision flow.
The Result Contract must explicitly state that the real local installation remains absent and real Harness state was not modified.

The Result Contract must use schema_version 2, second-precision timezone-aware timeline.started_at/timeline.completed_at, and validator-owned result_validation evidence from `node .agent-workflow/validator/validate-contract.mjs result docs/agent-results/DSH-VISION-RC1-BROWSER-REGRESSION-007-result.json --stamp` after completion time is final.
On completion, delete docs/agent-tasks/ACTIVE_TASK.json and commit/push only the Result Contract plus ACTIVE task deletion.
